phases.name: Ready
phases.intent: Right-lead stance; fists held in guard

phases.name: Step
phases.intent: Advance the right foot and plant it before punching

phases.name: Right Punch
phases.intent: Drive a closed right fist forward, then begin retracting

phases.name: Hip Turn
phases.intent: Retract the punch and rotate the pelvis to load the rear left leg

phases.name: Chamber
phases.intent: Lift the left knee while the right foot supports the body

phases.name: High Kick
phases.intent: Raise and straighten the left leg, with the toes pointing through the kick

phases.name: Follow
phases.intent: Continue the high kick with a straight knee and pointed foot; recoil starts next

phases.name: Recoil
phases.intent: Fold the left knee before returning the leg

phases.name: Recover
phases.intent: Replace the rear foot and restore the torso and fists to guard

phases.name: Guard
phases.intent: Hold the advanced stance, ready for the next action
